description: Check a scene for what Godot gets silently wrong when it loads or runs it. Errors: connections to handlers or nodes that do not exist, signals the source does not have, handlers taking the wrong number of arguments, unknown node types, scripts whose base type does not fit the node, missing parents, duplicate names and duplicate unique names, and changes to nodes that do not exist in an instanced scene. Warnings: unknown properties, values of the wrong type, and NodePaths to nodes not in the scene. Returns: per-scene problems with kind, severity and detail; valid means no errors. WHEN TO CALL: after editing a .tscn, or after renaming or removing a signal handler in GDScript. Godot accepts all of these with no error or only a console warning. Facts come from the engine; handler existence from the LSP's parse of the attached script.
name: scene_validate
